import io,json,logging,statistics,subprocess,sys,time,types,hashlib
import pikepdf
from app.workers import pdf_ops as after
from app.workers.pdf_types import Point
before=types.ModuleType('app.workers.pdf_ops_before_b')
before.__file__='app/workers/pdf_ops.py'
sys.modules[before.__name__]=before
code=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','79f05a399cb1669e6fb7cd1b84babfcbc7e3aebc:backend/app/workers/pdf_ops.py'],text=True,encoding='utf-8')
exec(compile(code,before.__file__,'exec'),before.__dict__)
rows=[]
expected=None
for lap in range(22):
    variants=(('before',before),('after',after))
    if lap%2:variants=variants[::-1]
    for variant,module in variants:
        logbuf=io.StringIO()
        handler=logging.StreamHandler(logbuf)
        handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter('%(levelname)s %(message)s'))
        log=module.logger
        log.setLevel(logging.INFO)
        log.handlers=[handler]
        log.propagate=False
        start=time.perf_counter()
        with pikepdf.Pdf.new() as pdf:
            page=pdf.add_blank_page(page_size=(1000,1000))
            ocg=module.add_ocg(pdf,'CUT')
            shape=module.new_shape(pdf,page)
            for n in range(1000):
                x=1.+n%30*30
                y=1.+n//30*25
                shape.draw_line(Point(x,y),Point(x+10,y))
                shape.draw_line(Point(x+10,y),Point(x+10,y+10))
                shape.finish(color=(0,1,0,0),width=.5,oc=ocg)
            shape.commit()
            target=io.BytesIO()
            pdf.save(target,static_id=True)
        wall=(time.perf_counter()-start)*1000
        raw=target.getvalue()
        digest=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
        if expected is None:expected=digest
        assert digest==expected
        rows.append(dict(lap=lap,warmup=lap<2,variant=variant,wallMs=round(wall,3),logs=len(logbuf.getvalue().splitlines()),pdfSha256=digest))
summary=[]
for variant in ('before','after'):
    values=[r for r in rows if not r['warmup'] and r['variant']==variant]
    summary.append(dict(variant=variant,n=len(values),medianMs=statistics.median(r['wallMs'] for r in values),logs=sorted(set(r['logs'] for r in values))))
print(json.dumps(dict(scope='1000 ShapeBuilder CUT paths, INFO logger, StringIO synchronous handler, save PDF; not whole export/real disklogging',samePdfBytes=True,summary=summary,rows=rows)))

import hashlib,json,logging,statistics,subprocess,sys,time,types
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from app.core import nesting_preview_capacity as after
from app.core import nesting_manifest_store as store
from app.workers import nup_artwork as live_artwork
import app.workers as worker_package
logging.disable(logging.CRITICAL)
def old_module(name,path):
    module=types.ModuleType(name)
    module.__file__=str(Path('../'+path).resolve())
    sys.modules[name]=module
    code=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','79f05a399cb1669e6fb7cd1b84babfcbc7e3aebc:'+path],text=True,encoding='utf-8')
    exec(compile(code,module.__file__,'exec'),module.__dict__)
    return module
before_artwork=old_module('app.workers.nup_artwork_before_d','backend/app/workers/nup_artwork.py')
before=old_module('app.core.nesting_preview_capacity_before_d','backend/app/core/nesting_preview_capacity.py')
root=Path('..').resolve()
evidence=json.loads((root/'docs/audit/BINH_TEM_BE_HIEU_NANG_EVIDENCE_2026-09-07.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
refs=evidence['nestingRuns'][2]['records'][0]['renderRecords']
fixture=root/'backend/.audit-tmp/userfile-timing-20260905-2n0v09te/runtime-data/manifests'
scenes=[]
for ref in refs:
    raw=store._read_regular_file(fixture/(ref['manifestId']+'.json'))
    decoded=store._decode_record_core(raw,expected_manifest_id=ref['manifestId'],expected_layout_fingerprint=ref['layoutFingerprint'])
    production=decoded.production_request
    job=SimpleNamespace(sheet_height_mm=production.engine_request['sheet']['heightMm'],parts=[SimpleNamespace(part_id=p['partId'],page_index=p['pages']['front']['pageIndex']) for p in production.render_bundle['parts']])
    session=SimpleNamespace(solved=SimpleNamespace(production_request=production,manifest=decoded.manifest))
    scenes.append((job,session))
rows=[]
expected=None
try:
    for lap in range(22):
        variants=(('before',before,before_artwork),('after',after,live_artwork))
        if lap%2:variants=variants[::-1]
        for variant,capacity,artwork in variants:
            sys.modules['app.workers.nup_artwork']=artwork
            worker_package.nup_artwork=artwork
            started=time.perf_counter()
            values=[capacity._project_sheet_cells(job,session) for job,session in scenes]
            wall=1000*(time.perf_counter()-started)
            digest=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(values,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
            if expected is None:expected=digest
            assert digest==expected
            rows.append(dict(lap=lap,warmup=lap<2,variant=variant,wallMs=round(wall,3),cells=sum(len(v) for v in values),sha256=digest))
        if lap%5==0:print('LAP '+str(lap),flush=True)
finally:
    sys.modules['app.workers.nup_artwork']=live_artwork
    worker_package.nup_artwork=live_artwork
summary=[]
for variant in ('before','after'):
    values=[r['wallMs'] for r in rows if not r['warmup'] and r['variant']==variant]
    summary.append(dict(variant=variant,n=len(values),medianMs=round(statistics.median(values),3),minMs=min(values),maxMs=max(values)))
print('RESULT '+json.dumps(dict(scope='real projection function on13fixed validatedpublishedmanifests,659cells; not wholepreview; baseline code fromHEAD inisolatedmodule',sameResponse=True,summary=summary,records=rows)))

"""A/B F trên một bộ manifest cố định; chỉ ghi kho benchmark riêng."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ast
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import logging
import os
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
BACKEND = ROOT / "backend"
sys.path.insert(0, str(BACKEND))


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--iterations", type=int, default=20)
    parser.add_argument("--warmups", type=int, default=2)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    run_root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="prynx_manifest_F_")).resolve()
    assert run_root.parent == Path(tempfile.gettempdir()).resolve()
    print("ROOT=" + str(run_root), flush=True)
    os.environ["DEV_MODE"] = "true"
    os.environ["PRYNX_TRUE_SHAPE_NESTING_ENABLED"] = "true"
    os.environ["PRYNX_PERF"] = "1"
    os.environ["PRYNX_PERF_DIR"] = str(run_root / "perf")
    os.environ["PRYNX_MIXED_NESTING_DATA_DIR"] = str(run_root / "runtime-data")
    from app.config import settings as config
    config.UPLOAD_DIR = run_root / "uploads"
    config.RESULTS_DIR = run_root / "results"
    config.UPLOAD_DIR.mkdir()
    config.RESULTS_DIR.mkdir()
    logging.disable(logging.CRITICAL)
    import pikepdf
    import pdfcompare_native
    from app.core import nesting_manifest_store as ms
    from app.core import nesting_preview_capacity as capacity
    from app.core import nesting_preview_session as session
    from app.core import nesting_production_pipeline as pipeline
    from app.core import mixed_nesting_service as service
    from app.core.perf_sampler import ProcessRssSampler
    from app.workers import nup_true_shape_nesting as nesting
    import runpy
    helpers = runpy.run_path(str(BACKEND / ".audit-tmp/f2_driver_e3b.py"))
    evidence = json.loads((ROOT / "docs/audit/BINH_TEM_BE_HIEU_NANG_EVIDENCE_2026-09-07.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    source = ROOT / "test/test nesting.pdf"
    source_hash = sha(source)
    settings = copy.deepcopy(evidence["nestingRuns"][2]["settings"])
    capacity._build_step_repeat_preview(
        str(source), settings, job_id="audit-f-fixed", cancel_event=None,
        progress_callback=None, subscriber_id="audit-f-fixed", legacy_preview_for_page=None,
        allow_legacy_fallback=False, raise_if_cancelled=lambda: None,
    )
    attached = nesting.attach_preview_session_reference(copy.deepcopy(settings), str(source), job_id="audit-f-export")
    references = attached[session.SESSION_REFERENCE_SETTING]
    assert len(references) == 13
    store = ms.NestingManifestStore()
    original_load = ms.NestingManifestStore.load_many
    loaded = store.load_many(references)
    expected = [(r.manifest_id, r.layout_fingerprint, digest(r.manifest)) for r in loaded]
    placed = sum(len(r.manifest["placements"]) for r in loaded)
    del loaded
    # Nạp CHỈ method trước F, dùng cùng validator/source helpers hiện hành.
    raw = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "79f05a399cb1669e6fb7cd1b84babfcbc7e3aebc:backend/app/core/nesting_manifest_store.py"], cwd=ROOT, text=True, encoding="utf-8")
    tree = ast.parse(raw)
    cls = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == "NestingManifestStore")
    function = next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == "load_many")
    namespace = dict(ms.__dict__)
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[function], type_ignores=[]), "<before-F-load-many>", "exec"), namespace)
    legacy_load = namespace["load_many"]
    solve_calls = []
    original_solve = pipeline.solve_production_nesting_job
    def unexpected_solve(*a, **kw):
        solve_calls.append(True)
        raise AssertionError("Xuất từ reference không được solve lại")
    pipeline.solve_production_nesting_job = unexpected_solve
    rows = []
    raster_hash = None
    def measure(fn):
        sampler = ProcessRssSampler(os.getpid(), interval_ms=50)
        sampler.start()
        start, cpu = time.perf_counter(), time.process_time()
        try:
            fn()
        finally:
            wall = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
            cpu_ms = (time.process_time() - cpu) * 1000
            sampler.stop()
        return dict(wallMs=round(wall, 3), cpuMs=round(cpu_ms, 3), peakRssMb=sampler.peak_mb, rssSamples=sampler.sample_count)
    try:
        for lap in range(args.warmups + args.iterations):
            variants = (("before", legacy_load), ("after", original_load))
            if lap % 2:
                variants = variants[::-1]
            for name, method in variants:
                ms.NestingManifestStore.load_many = method
                def load():
                    records = store.load_many(references)
                    assert [(r.manifest_id, r.layout_fingerprint, digest(r.manifest)) for r in records] == expected
                load_metrics = measure(load)
                output = run_root / (name + ".pdf")
                export_metrics = measure(lambda: nesting.run_true_shape_nesting(
                    str(source), str(output), attached, job_id="audit-f-export",
                ))
                with pikepdf.Pdf.open(output) as pdf:
                    pages = len(pdf.pages)
                    assert pages == 26
                pixel_digest = None
                if lap in (args.warmups, args.warmups + args.iterations - 1):
                    pixel_digest = helpers["raster_pdf_digest"](output, scale=0.5)
                    if raster_hash is None:
                        raster_hash = pixel_digest
                    assert pixel_digest == raster_hash
                assert sha(source) == source_hash
                assert service._SHARED_BATCH_WORKER_GRANTS.snapshot() == {"capacity": 0, "held": 0, "batches": 0, "waiters": 0}
                row = dict(lap=lap, warmup=lap < args.warmups, variant=name, load=load_metrics, export=export_metrics, pages=pages, pixelDigest=pixel_digest)
                rows.append(row)
                print(json.dumps(row), flush=True)
                (run_root / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(dict(settings=settings, references=references, placed=placed, sourceSha256=source_hash, native=json.loads(pdfcompare_native.MixedNestingRun.capabilities()), rows=rows), indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    finally:
        ms.NestingManifestStore.load_many = original_load
        pipeline.solve_production_nesting_job = original_solve
        session.reset_preview_session_store()
    summary = []
    for name in ("before", "after"):
        for phase in ("load", "export"):
            selected = [r[phase] for r in rows if not r["warmup"] and r["variant"] == name]
            times = sorted(r["wallMs"] for r in selected)
            summary.append(dict(variant=name, phase=phase, n=len(times), medianMs=statistics.median(times), p95Ms=times[max(0, __import__("math").ceil(.95*len(times))-1)], minMs=min(times), maxMs=max(times), peakRssMb=max(r["peakRssMb"] or 0 for r in selected)))
    print("SUMMARY " + json.dumps(dict(summary=summary, placed=placed, sourceUnchanged=True, unexpectedSolves=len(solve_calls), sameRaster=True, root=str(run_root))), flush=True)
    print("RAW=" + str(run_root / "result.json"), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
F.method: Same published13manifests/659placements. Before only substitutes pre-F load_many method with same validator/source and current D/E writer. 2warmups+20 interleaved; loaddata identity checked eachsample; all26pages raster atfirst/last measured pair, outside timers.
